author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to edit videos with ChatGPT Codex using AI. In this step-by-step tutorial, I’ll take 16 completely unedited video clips and see if Codex can turn them into a polished, finished video.

You’ll see how to set up a video editing project in Codex, install the Hyperframes plugin, give Codex access to your raw footage, and use a simple prompt to have AI analyze, cut, sequence, and edit the clips. We’ll also add captions, text overlays, music, and an AI-generated opening graphic, then refine the finished video using voice.

By the end, you’ll see just how much of the video editing process ChatGPT Codex can handle on its own.
